limitations: Local subprocess tests do not establish provider schema compatibility or semantic efficacy.
No hard real-time, hostile-code sandbox, hermetic environment or immutable remote model identity is claimed.
POSIX process group containment excludes descendants that create a new session; reaping observation is for the root.
Worker launches and boundary invocations do not count hidden provider requests.
Crashes or I/O errors can leave incomplete journals with consumed claims; no automatic resume.
Real inference requires a new concrete frozen protocol, content/destination and explicitly authorized budget.
